description: This file contains unit tests for multifaceted grain functionality in an Orleans-based distributed system. It tests accessing grains through multiple interfaces, type safety of interface casting, factory methods returning grain facets, and passing grain references around. The class 'MultifacetGrainTest' extends test infrastructure and includes test methods using Xunit to verify different aspects of multi-interface grains.

classes.name: MultifacetGrainTest
classes.description: Contains tests for verifying multifaceted grain behavior such as interface casting, factory creation of grain facets, and interface argument passing.

methods.name: RWReferences
methods.description: Tests retrieving and interacting with a grain through different interface facets, ensuring they reference the same underlying grain.

methods.name: RWReferencesInvalidCastException
methods.description: Verifies that casting a grain reference to an unsupported interface throws an InvalidCastException.

methods.name: MultifacetFactory
methods.description: Tests factory methods that produce different grain facets, ensuring proper interaction.

methods.name: Multifacet_InterfacesAsArguments
methods.description: Tests passing grain interface references as arguments between grains to verify they operate on the same grain instance.
